posts.subject: [ENG] Application Point System
posts.bodyHtml:
----------------------------------------
Application Point System
----------------------------------------

----------------------------------------


Declined Application = 1 Point


Kicked out of Administrator Team = 2 Points


Application Lock = 3 Points


----------------------------------------


- Once your application is declined you can submit next application after 1 month.


- The same applies if your second application gets declined, you will be able to submit the next application after 1 month time.


- If your third application gets rejected you receive a application lock, which is only available to be removed after a certain time and conversation with the leadership.


----------------------------------------


- If you get removed from the Administrator team due to excessive inactivity you will NOT get a point.


- If you been Full Administrator at Dream before you will comeback to this position.


- In the case you were in a Team but due to differences you were removed you can apply again, if this get declined you will get a application lock ( 3 points )


----------------------------------------


The above rules apply to ALL ranks of Administrators, as well forum moderators.
